title: RIO Receipt
description: Canonical receipt schema for the RIO protocol. This is the single authoritative definition. All receipt definitions in this repository MUST match this schema. Source of truth: test vectors in tests/vectors/.

receipt_version.description: Protocol version of this receipt format

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with microsecond precision and UTC timezone (Z suffix)

runtime_id.description: Identifier of the runtime that produced this receipt

request_summary.description: Human-readable summary of the original request

request_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonical request payload

request_canonical_payload.description: The canonical representation of the original request

policy_bundle_id.description: Identifier of the policy bundle used for evaluation

policy_bundle_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the policy bundle

decision.description: Final decision: allow (execution proceeds), block (execution denied), escalate (requires human review), modify (execution narrowed to stated parameters)

invariant_results.description: Results of invariant checks (boolean pass/fail for each invariant)

threshold_results.description: Results of threshold evaluations (scores and thresholds)

model_output_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the model output

model_output_preview.description: Truncated preview of the model output

prev_ledger_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the previous ledger entry. For the first receipt, this is SHA-256('GENESIS') = 901131d838b17aac0f7885b81e03cbdc9f5157a00343d30ab22083685ed1416a

public_key_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the Ed25519 public key used to sign this receipt

receipt_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonical JSON of all signed fields (all fields except receipt_hash, signature, and signature_algorithm)

signature_algorithm.description: Signing algorithm. Always Ed25519 for receipts.

signature.description: Base64-encoded Ed25519 signature over the canonical JSON of the signed fields
